standardizes: Registration, discovery, description, schema, invocation, cancellation, and lifecycle behavior for tools exposed by a web document to browser or embedded agents.
does_not_standardize: Remote MCP transports, an agent runtime, generic browser automation, or the application-specific semantics and authorization policy behind each web tool.
